title: Contextual prompting: supplying the right context

videos.script: A customer writes to a café asking for their money back. You paste the message into a chat window and ask for a reply. {{ask}} The reply is polite and fluent. It also promises a cash refund the café never gives. {{wrong}} The model did nothing strange. It has never seen the café's rules, so it wrote what a refund reply usually says. {{usual}} The fix is not a cleverer instruction. It is the facts the model was missing. Who the reply is for, what it will be used for, the limits it must keep, and the handbook page itself. {{facts}} In this lesson you add that context to a prompt and arrange it so the model can use it. Material first, marked with tags, and the question at the end. {{arrange}} Then you count what it costs, because context is sent again on every request. {{count}}
